title: Leonardo Chavarria Jr. ED
body:
Leonardo Chavarria Jr. Appointed as TIDE Executive Director

After a successful three-month transition period, TIDE Board of Directors is pleased to announce the appointment of Leonardo Chavarria Jr. as Executive Director.
Mr. Chavarria brings a wealth of experience to this role, as well as a Master’s degree in Business Administration and Sustainable Development. Mr. Chavarria also possesses a strong background in project management and development, coupled with five years of dedicated service to TIDE’s conservation efforts.

Having closely shadowed the previous Executive Directors, Mr. Chavarria possesses an in-depth understanding of TIDE’s commitments, partnerships, and vision.

We are confident that Mr. Chavarria will effectively lead TIDE in continuing its vital work and achieving continued success.

“I am both humbled and honoured to assume this new role as the Executive Director of our great TIDE. This is a meaningful moment for me, and I want to express my deepest gratitude to the Board of Directors, the leadership team, and each one of you who has placed your trust in me. I am truly proud to embark on this journey together with such a passionate, dedicated, and talented group of individuals.” – Leonardo Chavarria Jr. 

“I am deeply grateful to my predecessors and everyone who has helped lay the groundwork for the success of this organization. Your dedication, vision, and hard work have made our achievements possible. I stand on the foundation you’ve built, and I am committed to honouring that legacy by advancing TIDE’s mission and expanding on the remarkable progress already made. I will continue to be dedicated to every individual we serve, every partner we work with, and every member of our community.” – Leonardo Chavarria Jr.
